deterministic_pagination.detail: Bybit branch uses cursor pagination with oldest-1 continuation; Binance branch uses whole-month archives. Reviewed as code only — not executed.

duplicate_detection.detail: Both branches dedupe by timestamp key rather than rejecting duplicates. The R1 contract requires rejection: a duplicate is a provider defect to be reported, not smoothed over.

funding_authority.detail: Bybit branch fetches funding history with a conservative synthetic fallback. A synthetic fallback cannot back a net economic claim under this contract.

hashing.detail: No sha256 of downloaded archive bytes in either branch.

missing_bar_detection.detail: Neither branch performs any gap or completeness validation; holes are skipped silently.

no_synthetic_as_edge_evidence.detail: data/artifacts/synthetic_btcusdt is a CI fixture and is recorded as non-citable in the governance gap record.

provenance.detail: No retrieval timestamp, no immutable pin, no manifest.

real_public_data.detail: data.binance.vision and api.bybit.com are unreachable from this sandbox; zero crypto bytes were retrieved, so nothing could be hashed or verified.

utc_normalization.detail: Open-time ms normalization present; the bar-open convention is not frozen in a contract.

promotion_preconditions: Network access to a real crypto venue archive from the executing environment (the hard blocker today).
Raw byte sha256 recorded BEFORE any derivation, with an immutable pin.
Gap inventory against the 24/7 grid with every hole dated and classified.
Duplicate timestamps REJECTED rather than deduplicated.
Real funding history for any perpetual economic claim; no synthetic fallback may back a net number.
Reuse of the R1 canonical schema, CAS and partition registry rather than a parallel crypto-only pipeline.

required_contracts.deterministic_pagination: Cursor/segment walk that provably terminates and yields the same set every run.
required_contracts.funding_authority: Real funding history for perpetual economics.
required_contracts.hashing: sha256 of raw bytes before derivation; dataset hash after.
required_contracts.missing_bar_detection: Expected-vs-actual bar inventory against the 24/7 grid, every gap dated and classified.
required_contracts.no_synthetic_as_edge_evidence: Synthetic fixtures structurally excluded from evidence paths.
required_contracts.provenance: Venue, endpoint, retrieval timestamp, immutable pin.
required_contracts.real_public_data: Bytes from a real public venue archive, retrieved and hashed in this environment.
required_contracts.utc_normalization: Epoch-ms open time, bar-open convention frozen.
